description: APEX faucet on Arc (Circle USDC chain, eip155:5042): the pot, the amount per claim (USDC + APEX), claims left today and left right now (the day's claims open in three parts, at 00:00, 08:00 and 16:00 UTC; nextReleaseAt says when), cooldown. Every number is read from the faucet contract at call time; a failed read is reported as failed, never as zero. Free.
name: arc_faucet_status
